episodes.description: Anaphylaxis within 10 minutes of oral amoxicillin prescribed for a dental abscess: generalised urticaria, lip and tongue swelling, hypotension 78/40 mmHg. Treated with intramuscular adrenaline 0.5 mg, IV fluids, chlorphenamine and hydrocortisone. Observed for 12 hours; penicillin allergy recorded as severe.

Irregularly irregular pulse found at a routine blood pressure check; ECG confirmed atrial fibrillation with ventricular rate 104 bpm. CHA2DS2-VASc score 4 (age, sex, hypertension, diabetes). Started on apixaban and bisoprolol.
Annual chronic disease review: eGFR 48 mL/min/1.73m2 (stable CKD stage G3a), HbA1c 54 mmol/mol, blood pressure 138/82 mmHg. Apixaban dose criteria reviewed and standard dose continued.

current_medication.name: Apixaban
current_medication.indication: Stroke prevention in non-valvular atrial fibrillation

current_medication.name: Metformin
current_medication.dose: 1 g once daily with the evening meal

pathologies.notes: Diet and metformin; no retinopathy at last screening.
Stable eGFR 45-50; relevant to drug dosing.
